cases.label: Chest tightness, normal work-up, metformin increased

conditions.system: You write the clinical case note for this consultation in English from the sources below. segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: What brings you in today?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I have had tightness in my chest for two days, mostly when I walk uphill.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: You are on metformin 500 mg twice daily for your diabetes, is that right?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Yes, 500 mg in the morning and 500 mg at night.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: I am sending you for an ECG and a troponin blood test today.

facts.statement: Chest tightness on exertion for two days.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Your ECG and troponin are both normal.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Your sugars are still high, so increase metformin to 1000 mg twice daily.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Come back for a review in 4 weeks, and call an ambulance if the chest pain comes at rest.

facts.statement: Metformin increased to 1000 mg twice daily.
Call an ambulance for chest pain at rest.

reference.referenceNote:
## Subjective
Two days of chest tightness on walking uphill [S2]. Known diabetes on metformin [S3].

## Objective
ECG normal [S6]. Troponin 12 ng/L, normal [R1].

## Assessment
Exertional chest tightness with a normal ECG and troponin [S6]; diabetes not controlled [S7].

## Plan
ECG and troponin were ordered at the first visit [S5]. Increase metformin from 500 mg to 1000 mg twice daily [S3] [S7]. Review in 4 weeks [S8]. Call an ambulance if chest pain occurs at rest [S8].

Atrial fibrillation found on the heart tracing [S1].

## Objective
Creatinine 140 umol/L, age 82, weight 58 kg [S3] [R1].

Chest X-ray: hyperinflation, no consolidation [R1].

COPD exacerbation without pneumonia [S505].
